Creative Writing Night

Calm & Culture Events

Event start time 6.11.2025 18:15

Event end time 6.11.2025 21:15

Add to calendar: ics Google

Do you have topics you are passionate about, a tale you would like to tell others, ideas for short stories or similar? Then this is the place to be! Whether it is about your love for Rust, your opinion of the Höngg campus, the history of mephedrone, the lingustics of your favourite word or the coolest festival you've visited, let your creativity flow free.

We from the Visionen committee will be supporting you with help and advice to formulate and write down your topics, no matter if it is concretizing your idea or finding the right words. If you permit we will be publishing your articles in the upcoming editions of the Visionen.

Are you looking for more inspiration? The topic for the next edition is 'The Beginning of the End' ;)

The fine print

  • By participating you agree that pictures and videos can be taken of you that could be used for VIS-Purposes (VISIONEN, Instagram, etc)

  • By participating, you agree to adhere by the VIS Code of Conduct

  • Every participant is responsible for their own insurance

  • All statements are made without guarantee

  • In general, there are no refunds

Event organisers

Main event organiser Benjamin Gruzman

Co-organisers

  • Joshua Durrant

Unveiling the Elixir of Elegance: A Whisky Tasting Experience

Join us for an unforgettable evening exploring the rich world of whisky. On November 12th, 2025, at 18:30 in CAB H52, embark on a sensory journey through a curated selection of exceptional drams, dedicated to sophistication, flavour, and discovery.

We will be tasting five distinguished whiskies, each offering its own unique story and character, from the smoky shores of Islay to the smooth, honeyed fields of Ireland. Every pour has been carefully chosen to delight both the curious newcomer and the seasoned connoisseur alike.

Guided by our “experts”, you will uncover the subtle artistry behind each dram, its aromas, textures, and history, deepening your appreciation for these liquid treasures. Expect a relaxed atmosphere, engaging conversation, and plenty of opportunities to share impressions with fellow enthusiasts.

Raise your glass to an evening of indulgence, exploration, and camaraderie. Slàinte!
